title: Aws Security Advisories - 2026-07-23
description:
Merged 2 aws security advisories published on 2026-07-23. Original advisory IDs: 2026-064-aws, aws-2026-07-23

Titles:
- CVE-2026-16756 - Allocation of resources without limits in the default aws-smithy-http-server serve() path allows unauthenticated Slowloris denial of service
- Aws Security Advisories - 2026-07-23
affected: aws:Smithy-RS is a Rust code generation and runtime framework that generates HTTP clients and servers from Smithy interface definitions, powering the AWS SDK for Rust and custom service implementations. We identified

aws:The AWS Bedrock AgentCore Python SDK (bedrock-agentcore) provides tools for building AI agents, including a Code Interpreter client that installs Python packages into a managed sandbox. We identified

aws:The AWS API MCP Server (awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server) is an open-source MCP server that lets AI assistants execute AWS CLI commands against a user's AWS account. It includes an optional, user-configured security policy that can deny or gate specific AWS operations. We identified
